About The Role
 In this role, you will contribute to the development of a resilient IT infrastructure for an intergovernmental organization that supports inventors in obtaining patent protection across up to 40 European countries. You will help drive digital transformation across the patent-granting process and corporate services, working with cutting-edge technologies to build reliable, secure, and efficient solutions. Your work will support innovation across Europe while contributing to the development of an effective global patent system, with a strong focus on technical excellence, IT security, and the adoption of new technologies.
 Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain Python applications and services, ensuring they meet the highest standards of quality and performance
Work closely with cross-functional teams to define, design, and build custom applications using Writer’s full-stack platform
Develop and maintain microservices to support our applications and ensure seamless integration
Optimize application performance, ensuring high availability, scalability, and accuracy
Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code that adheres to best practices and industry standards
Troubleshoot and debug issues in production environments to maintain system stability and reliability
Create and optimize base prompts that will enhance our customers’ app pipelines, ensuring they are effective and efficient
Collaborate with the team to design, develop, and evaluate prompt chains for specific content creation applications
Work with stakeholders in Customer Success to scope customer applications and ensure they meet business needs
Maintain clear and comprehensive documentation of engineering processes and outcomes, and share innovative techniques with the team
Collaborate with engineering team members to integrate your work seamlessly into our product, ensuring a cohesive user experience
Conduct thorough testing and debugging to ensure the reliability and performance of generative AI applications
 Requirements
Experienced with 3+ years of Python development, using Airflow, JupyterLab, Fast API
Skilled with GCP, Kubernetes, CI/CD: GitHub, ArgoCD.
Strong knowledge and affinity for unit and integration testing.
Skilled in problem-solving with a keen attention to detail
Excellent in communication and collaboration within a team environment
